💥 SQL Server or Databricks? Choose wrong, and you could lose time, money, and momentum.

• Vertical vs. horizontal scaling
• Cost models: license vs. usage-based
• Real-world decision grid
• When to use both together (yes, that’s a thing!)

• Data Engineers & Architects
